summary: Build a new marketing website for a sofa cleaning service (Magical Service / Magical Sofa Cleaning) targeting Ahmedabad & Gandhinagar, with English + Gujarati mixed user-facing content.
architectural_notes: Content language requirement changed to English + Gujarati mix (bilingual/mixed copy) across the site.
Services scope update: remove Home Cleaning; offer Sofa, Carpet, Chair, Mattress cleaning + AC Water Jet service.
Explicit scope constraint: no AI features should be added (now or future).
known_issues: Potential conflict: existing scope requires all user-facing text in English, but latest requirement is English + Gujarati mix.

existing_features.title: Create a new single-page marketing website for a sofa cleaning service, based on the provided HTML content structure (Hero, Services, Contact CTAs, Footer), implemented in the existing React + Tailwind app.
Use English for all user-facing text while preserving the business intent from the user’s drafts: promote sofa cleaning and related services, and target Ahmedabad & Gandhinagar.
Implement prominent contact CTAs using the exact phone number and WhatsApp link shown in the user’s HTML drafts: phone link tel:+918000262644 and WhatsApp link https://wa.me/918000262644.

Add a Services section that includes at minimum Sofa Cleaning plus additional services reflected in the user’s drafts (e.g., AC Service, Home Cleaning, Carpet/Mattress cleaning), each displayed as a card with short descriptions and optional pricing text like “From ₹99/Seat”.
Add an “Areas Served” section listing locations mentioned in the user drafts (at minimum: Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Nikol, Naroda).
Create a coherent, premium “cleaning service” visual theme and apply it consistently (colors, typography, spacing, buttons, cards). Do not use a blue/purple primary palette.

Add generated static images (hero background + simple brand logo) to the project under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the landing page (do not fetch hero imagery from external URLs).

Update the landing page content to use a mixed-language style (English + Gujarati) across all visible sections (Header, Hero, Services, Areas Served, Footer) by adding Gujarati alongside the existing English copy, while keeping the same page structure, CTAs, and contact links unchanged.
Update the Services section to remove the “Full Home Cleaning” service card entirely.

Update the Services section offerings to include exactly these services: Sofa Cleaning, Carpet Cleaning, Chair Cleaning, Mattress Cleaning, and AC Water Jet Service (keeping the existing bilingual style used on the page).
Do not add any AI-based features (now or as placeholder “future” functionality) anywhere in the website.
